dispatches.title: Red-team the BATCH-003 conclusions and the round-split rule

objective: Execute GOAL-AES-003 BATCH-003 in the rank order DEC-20260802-b226fb fixed. RANK 1 IS THE SEGMENT-3 REVIEW: BATCH-002's two four-zero-matrix arms were run AFTER its reviewers were dispatched, so they are measured-but-unreviewed and carry no weight in EV-AES-d8a13e. Until they are independently re-executed, the r=5 half of the round-split scoping rule in CORR-20260802-46b73b rests on reviewed ANALYSIS rather than reviewed MEASUREMENT -- which is exactly why DEC-20260802-b226fb refused to promote that rule to a knowledge entry. RANK 2 is the cross-instrument anchor between BATCH-001's AES-NI engine and BATCH-002's software engine, the one unresolved confound that could invalidate every cross-batch comparison this campaign has made; their conventions were read across BY EYE and never anchored. RANK 4 finishes the hint-corruption coverage at slots t=1 and t=2, which BATCH-002's prefix-only corruption could not reach. A falsification on any of these is a legitimate outcome.
